**Source: same external audit @ `2ec47d8`. Independently re-verified, measured.** `season?: ActiveSeasonGoalInfo` (`StudentDialog.tsx:414`) defaults to `DEFAULT_SEASON_INFO` (`:424`); `StudentsTab.tsx:317-324` documents omitting it *specifically* to avoid "a false ordering dependency" with T091, which is **Passed** (ledger `:171`). The blocker cleared; the follow-through was never filed — the deferral lived only in a module comment, which is exactly the failure constitution item 20 exists to prevent, recorded here as a fifth instance of it. **Fifth instance of the defect family** behind three of the owner's four production bugs: optional prop + plausible fixture default + call site passing nothing (after `OutreachEventDialog.teams`, `ScheduleMeetingsDialog.teams`, `CoachHome.seasonId`, `Leaderboard.seasonId`). **Why it is latent rather than visible, which is also why nothing caught it:** `DEFAULT_SEASON_INFO` is `{ defaultGoalHours: 100 }` and the real column default is `not null default 100`, so the fixture is indistinguishable from correct until a season is created with a different goal — at which point the student dialog silently uses 100. **Sequencing with T151:** `StudentDialog` carries a *fourth* optional-prop-with-fixture-default that T151's premise did not account for. T151 must not make `season` required without T159 supplying the value, or it forces a breaking change with nothing to pass. Order T159 before or with T151.

**CORRECTION 2026-08-04.** This row comes from the **same external audit (`2ec47d8`) that was measured wrong on T161, T162, T163 and T321** — it counted **files named `<module>.test.ts`** rather than tests *of* a module. **Measured today, at least two of its ten named loaders already have dedicated test files:** `attendance.ts` (**12** tests) and `students.ts` (**23** tests, re-measured at `6c8b2dd` after T198 reworked that loader). The remaining eight (`teams`, `kiosk`, `seasons`, `invites`, `parents`, `accept`, `selfCheckoff`, `leaderboard_privacy`) have no dedicated file, but that is **not** the same as untested — T163 showed a loader can be covered entirely by its importers. **Do not treat this as ten untested loaders. Measure invocation, not filenames, and split the row by what is actually uncovered.** **Original row text follows.** **Source: external audit @ `2ec47d8`, "explicitly out of scope for this pass".** `teams.ts`, `kiosk.ts`, `attendance.ts`, `seasons.ts`, `students.ts`, `invites.ts`, `parents.ts`, `accept.ts`, `selfCheckoff.ts`, `leaderboard_privacy.ts`. Recorded as one row rather than ten, to be split when picked up. Context from T146's measurement: **81** `as …DbRow` casts across the loader directory, each able to hide an omitted column exactly as the `teams.color` bug did, against **zero** tests in the directory before T146. Roughly ten real sites use `.select('*')`, where a cast cannot hide an omission. The structural remedy — generated Supabase `Database` types, which would let the compiler catch omitted columns and make the casts unnecessary — remains unavailable (no generated types in repo; `client.ts`'s single `createClient` passes no `Database` generic) and is a separate, larger decision than any of T161–T167.

---

**BOUNDARY, added 2026-07-30 after the owner caught the orchestrator conflating the two halves.** T168 is **discovery only: it finds instances and produces findings. It fixes nothing.** Every instance found becomes its own work task through the normal worker→checker pipeline — as the five already found demonstrate: T151 (three dialogs' `teams`), T155 (`CoachHome.seasonId`), T158 (`Leaderboard.seasonId`), T159 (`StudentDialog.season`), T170 (`OutreachList.viewerStudentId`). So "finish T168" is a misleading phrase: completing the sweep leaves the whole remediation outstanding. **Consequence for delegation:** a plan-only session can perform T168's discovery and hand back drafts, but it cannot complete this row's remediation successors, and it must not be told it owns T168 — the orchestrator owns the row, the numbering, and every fix. Findings arrive as `docs/swarm/inbox/<branch>.md` and are folded in here. **Remediating the *mechanism* rather than the instances is separate work and is filed as T172.** **SWEEP RESULT, 2026-07-30 — `src/pages/**`/`src/components/**` is now covered** by external audit `claude/audit-batch-2` @ `c962b7f`, folded in and re-verified. It found **two** new confirmed instances (`StudentHome`'s three props → T176; `SubscribePopover.functionsBaseUrl` → T177), swept ~40 components clean with the per-component reasoning recorded in `docs/swarm/inbox/claude-audit-batch-2-t168-sweep.md`, and correctly declined to double-count `CoachHome.teamId` (already deferred by T155) and two props on unreachable components. **T168 is discovery-complete for the identity-placeholder shape. It is NOT complete for the class**, because verifying it surfaced a second shape the discriminator cannot see: a **function-typed default pointing at a fixture loader** (`ParentHome`, filed T181 — swept clean by the audit, yet its dashboard is entirely fabricated). Both shapes are the same defect; the second is harder to spot because `loadX` matches the codebase's legitimate DI convention. **A second discovery pass is needed for the fixture-loader shape before T168 can close**, and T172's mechanism must catch both or it will certify files like `ParentHome.tsx` as clean.
